appearance_facts.fact: Single blue line with circular markers descends from the top-left toward the bottom-right corner.
A light-blue shaded region fills the area under the line, widening as the line drops.
The final marker sits near the bottom of the plot, aligned with the last x-axis label.

printed_facts.fact: Title: 'Month vs. Number of COVID-19 patients hospitalized'.
Y-axis label 'Count'; ticks read 0, 2000, 4000, 6000, 8000 from top to bottom.
X-axis label 'Month'; labels run left-to-right from 'Feb 24, 2020' to 'Mar 14, 2020'.
Series starts near the 0 tick (Feb 24) and ends near the 8000 tick (Mar 14).

public_definitions: Use the dashboard trend to route this inpatient capacity review to the most appropriate operations pathway for the current period.
Option: Route to hospital surge-capacity planning guidance for rapidly increasing COVID-19 inpatient demand
Option: Route to step-down recovery planning for easing COVID-19 inpatient demand
Option: Route to routine respiratory surveillance updates for background monitoring
uncertain: The y-axis is inverted (0 at top, 8000 at bottom); the visual downward slope corresponds to a rising count from ~0 to ~8000.
No explicit 'current period' marker is shown; the rightmost date (Mar 14, 2020) is treated as the latest point.
